name: TrueSignal fire drill received
description: A Doppel fire drill reached the SIEM (event.kind: pipeline_test, labels.drill: true). Drills are sent by `doppel firedrill` (SIGUSR1) or a sensor in test mode to prove the sensor → Hub → SIEM path. Every alerting rule excludes them; this rule records that each drill arrived, for drill-success tracking (F-802). Informational, not an incident.
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: None: every match is a drill. A drill outside a planned test window means someone with Docker access on the node (or the node key) sent it; check the Hub audit and the node.
note:
## Triage
1. Expected after `doppel firedrill` on `host.name`: one alert per running sensor (`truesignal.sensor_id`). Fewer alerts than sensors means a broken path for the missing ones (sensor, node, Hub or SIEM output).
2. `truesignal.details.original_severity` is the severity the sensor would have reported; the Hub stores drills as `info`.
3. No drill was planned: someone ran `doppel firedrill` or sent SIGUSR1 on the node. Check who has Docker or root access there.
